summary.text: Crystal Brantley is a Republican who has served in the New Mexico Senate since 2021, representing District 35, which covers parts of Catron, Doña Ana, Grant, Hidalgo, Luna, Sierra and Socorro counties.
Brantley is ranking member of the Senate Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Brantley's occupation as business owner and a district office in Elephant Butte.

Brantley also sits on the Senate Rules Committee and the Senate Committees' Committee and, between sessions, on the Courts, Corrections and Justice Committee and the Interim Legislative Ethics Committee.
